data.body: Implemented the startup-handshake-only extraction. Added RED guards that require a separate rebar._mcp_startup_handshake leaf and prove _mcp_health re-exports the prior symbols, then moved the handshake cluster there while keeping _mcp_health as facade and _mcp_serving as the serving owner. Focused validation is green: tests/unit/test_mcp_health_startup_handshake.py, tests/unit/test_mcp_health_store_status.py, and tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_http_transport.py -k 'run_http_with_grace or handshake', plus make lint and make typecheck. Broad default pytest again reached only the already-known clean-origin/main lifecycle baseline cluster in tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py. Pushed as Gerrit change 2575 from commit 05fe054348e1.
